headline: A Flaw in ChatGPT’s Mac App Could Have Let Hackers Grab Sensitive Data
context: While the focus has been on AI agents’ hacking capabilities, a recently patched vulnerability in a ChatGPT app shows that AI software is itself an inviting—and vulnerable—target.
